name: graalvm
description: Installs GraalVM distribution for polyglot and native-image support. Provides Java runtime, conflicts with java-jdk.

graalvm_version.description: Complete SDKMAN 'java' candidate id to install: <version>-graalce for GraalVM Community, <version>-graal for Oracle GraalVM (e.g. 25.4.4.1+1-graalce, 21.0.2-graalce). Legacy GraalVM release numbering (22.3.1) has no candidate id and is ignored with a warning.
